notes:
One small change to the troubleshooting recorder.

**The recorder can now see the tablet's own log.** Last version's recorder could only record what Obbligato itself was doing. With this update it can also capture the screen's sleep and wake messages and the Bluetooth link, which is what is needed to chase a frozen panel or a page turn that does not reach the other tablet. The switch is still off unless you turn it on, and Android may ask you to allow one-time log access each time the recorder starts.

Nothing else changes. Your library, annotations and licence are not affected.
